recentItems.title: Trump Makes 9/11 About Himself, A.I. Ready to Kill Us & Jimmy to Interview James Talarico on YouTube
recentItems.description:
The first night of NFL football is upon us, Guillermo is a week away from competing on “Dancing with the Stars” and he is really hoping to lose weight so he does his official weigh in before the season starts, financial disclosures reveal that Trump gave cash gifts to various people that work him including $45,ooo to Natalie Harp, he has been busy this week making the 25th Anniversary of 9/11 about him, Ted Cruz sat down with Kaitlin Collins and gave his thoughts about it on CNN, Trump is attending the first-ever Republican midterm convention, tomorrow night Jimmy will be interviewing U.S. Senate candidate of Texas James Talarico under unusual circumstances as it will only be available on our YouTube Channel, Apple unveiled a new foldable phone, a researcher from a leading A.I. company named Anthropic quit his job because he fears for our lives, people building A.I. believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade, and data center companies have figured out a way to make something that isn’t very good for you seem very good for you.

recentItems.title: Jimmy Kimmel Recaps Trump’s Crazy Summer, Our Country Still Being a Mess & Our 4,000th Show
recentItems.description:
